Built around the contrasting themes of day and night, this special collector's box includes an Espeon ex foil card and Umbreon ex foil card, each featuring beautiful artwork inspired by Pokémon celebrating throughout the day and into the night.

Both cards can be showcased together using the included dual-card display frame, designed specifically to complement the bright daytime theme of Espeon and the darker nighttime theme of Umbreon.

The collection also includes two special layered celebration magnets, one featuring Espeon and Pokémon celebrating during the day, and the other featuring Umbreon surrounded by Pokémon celebrating at night. Each magnet uses multiple illustrated layers to create a three-dimensional display effect.

To complete the collection, you'll receive an impressive 15 Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration booster packs, each containing 6 cards from the special Simplified Chinese anniversary expansion.

products.body:
Celebrate 30 years of Pokémon with the Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Umbreon ex Deluxe Deck, a special Simplified Chinese Pokémon TCG release featuring one of the most popular Eeveelutions, Umbreon.

Built around Umbreon ex, this ready-to-play deck offers a fast and aggressive strategy. Umbreon ex's Moonlight Claw attack can deal an impressive 240 damage when your opponent's Active Pokémon already has damage counters on it, rewarding players who can set up damage before bringing Umbreon ex in for the finishing blow.

Alongside the Umbreon ex deck, the Deluxe Deck Set includes a selection of exclusive Umbreon-themed Pokémon TCG accessories, including a metal deck box, Pokémon coin and playmat. This makes the set a fantastic choice for Umbreon collectors as well as players looking for a complete themed deck experience.

The collection also includes two Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration booster packs, each containing 6 cards from the special Simplified Chinese anniversary expansion.
